title: BJP protests in Kalaburagi against milk price and bus fare hikes
seoTitle: Kalaburagi BJP protest over fare and milk hikes

tea.why: Protesters are angry over recent increases in milk, curd, and bus fares implemented by the state government.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand the immediate withdrawal of the milk price and bus fare hikes.
tea.changed: Nov 6: BJP workers and leaders staged a demonstration at the Central Bus Stand in Kalaburagi.

summary: On November 6, 2026, Bharatiya Janata Party workers and leaders staged a protest at the Central Bus Stand in Kalaburagi, Karnataka. Organised by the party's district unit, the demonstration targeted the Congress state government over increases in milk and curd prices, as well as a 30 per cent hike in bus fares. Leaders accused the government of burdening common people, daily commuters, low-income families, and farmers to finance its guarantee schemes. Protesters demanded the immediate withdrawal of the price increases, while speakers also raised issues regarding drought relief, sugarcane prices, and drinking water shortages.
demands: Immediate withdrawal of milk and curd price hikes
Immediate withdrawal of bus fare increases
response: No official government response to the protest was reported in the sources.

updates.text: The BJP's Kalaburagi district unit announced plans to stage a protest at the Central Bus Stand on Friday.
BJP workers and leaders staged the demonstration in Kalaburagi against milk, curd, and bus fare hikes.
